Missions.Title: Closing Time
Intro: Five years ago, Andrew walked away from the Ledger. The syndicate paid him to settle its debts.
He traded the work for a quiet armory on the edge of the city. Oil, brass, and silence.
Tonight, the Ledger has come to settle a debt with him.
Missions.AndrewStart: Five years. Couldn't even give me five years.

Boss.Name: Kade, the Collector
Boss.Taunt: Nothing personal, Andrew. The Ledger always collects.

Missions.Outro: Every one of them carried a matchbook from the Velvet Club.

Missions.Title: Velvet
Intro: The Velvet Club belongs to Silas Varga, the Ledger's newest underboss.
He put the price on Andrew's head, and he thinks the music is loud enough to hide behind.
Andrew goes in through the front door.

Boss.Name: Dorian Sloane
Boss.Taunt: Mister Varga sends his regards. And his best.
Boss.Mid: Do you have any idea what this carpet cost? Kill him!
Boss.Death: He'll... burn your whole life down for this.
Boss.AndrewReply: I'll send him yours back. In pieces.

Missions.Outro: Varga's books name a meeting tonight. The roof of the Nightjar Garage.

Missions.Title: Nightjar
Intro: Three levels of concrete stand between Andrew and the roof.
Varga's lieutenants are moving the money tonight, and every floor is watched.
Somewhere above, Mara Voss is counting the seconds.
Missions.AndrewStart: Top floor. Let's get this done.

Boss.Name: Mara Voss
Boss.Taunt: You should have stayed retired, Andrew.
Boss.Mid: You're slower than you used to be. Pin him down. Now.
Boss.AndrewReply: I tried, Mara. You people wouldn't let me.

Missions.Outro: The money is gone, and so is Varga. The trail ends at Ironwood Yard.

Missions.Title: Ironwood
Intro: Ironwood Yard is the Ledger's freight depot, and Silas Varga's last fortress.
He is waiting there with everyone he has left.
So is Andrew.

Boss.Name: Silas Varga
Boss.Taunt: Five years, Andrew. Five years, and you came back for this?
Boss.Mid: You think killing me closes the Ledger? It's a book, Andrew. Somebody always picks it up.
Boss.Death: Then you... write the next page.
Boss.AndrewReply: You came to my door first, Silas.

Missions.Outro: Varga's phone lit up in the mud. One message, from a number Andrew hadn't seen in five years. The Keeper will settle this himself.

Missions.Title: Cold Iron
Intro: Varga kept two sets of books. One burned with him. The other is still somewhere in Ironwood Yard.
Tonight the Ledger's cleaners are sweeping the yard, erasing every page and every witness.
Andrew leaves the car a mile out, and walks in through the dark.

Boss.Name: Ezra Kell, the Cleaner
Boss.Taunt: I clean up after the Keeper. You're just one more stain.
Boss.Mid: Stay still. This goes quicker if you stay still.
Boss.Death: He already knows... where you'll go next.

Missions.Outro: The book names the Keeper: Augustin Crane. And one more debt, marked to be paid at dawn. Theo Marsh.

Missions.Title: First Light
Intro: Theo Marsh keeps the Lantern House. Under its lamp, no contract may be served, and no name may be spoken.
Five years ago, Theo got Andrew out. Last night, he stepped outside the lamp's light to warn him.
Crane's people are holding him on the Nightjar roof. Andrew parks the car on the top deck, and starts down before the sun comes up.

Boss.Name: Petra Lind, the Auditor
Boss.Taunt: The Keeper balances every account. Even old friends.
Boss.Mid: You were the best we ever had. Now you're just late.
Boss.Death: Too late, Andrew. It was always too late.

Missions.Outro: Theo was gone before first light. He left his lantern, and a note in his careful hand. Live, Andrew.

Missions.Title: The Books
Intro: Ledger Tower. Forty floors of glass, where the syndicate keeps its accounts.
Every name, every price, every debt, written in Augustin Crane's own hand.
Andrew isn't here to read them.

Boss.Name: Teodor Brask, the Keeper's Hand
Boss.Taunt: Mister Crane is not available. I take his appointments.
Boss.Mid: We saw the grey Fastback in the lot. I knew it was you before the alarms did.
Boss.Death: Crane... is already on the water.

Missions.Outro: Crane's penthouse is empty. A freighter leaves Saltmarsh Terminal at four. He means to be on it.

Missions.Title: Dead Tide
Intro: Saltmarsh Terminal. Rain on steel, and a ship waiting in the dark.
Augustin Crane has kept the Ledger for thirty years. He has never once stood in a room with Andrew.
Tonight he will.
Missions.Objective: Stop Crane before the ship sails

Boss.Name: Augustin Crane, the Keeper
Boss.Taunt: You think this closes the Ledger? I only hold the pen.
Boss.Mid: Theo asked me to let you go. I should have listened to him.
Boss.Death: Write it down, then. Paid... in full.

Missions.Outro: The Ledger has no Keeper tonight. Andrew sets Theo's lantern on the water, starts the car, and drives home in the rain.

CrewSpotted.Text: Oh shit, that's him! That's him!
Eyes on target. Light him up.
Grey Fastback outside. It's him. It's really him.

CrewFlank.Text: Push him. Don't give him room.

CrewManDown.Text: Man down! He's dropping us one by one!
They said this would be easy!

CrewSearch.Text: Where'd he go? Check the corners.

CrewFear.Text: Nobody said it was him. Nobody said it was HIM!
He went through Varga's whole crew. Alone.
